name: octa-audit-export-v1
producer: OCTA governance gateway (PRIVATE -- this adapter does not ship in the public vlc-1 repo)
description: Maps GET /api/govern/audit-export to VLC-1. Each line of the JSONL is one audit entry exactly as the server serialized it; hash = SHA-256(hex(prev) + '|' + raw entry minus its trailing hash and signature members); every entry additionally carries an Ed25519 signature over its hash, and the export carries a signed head marker binding genesis, head, entry_count and pruned_total (verify the marker per docs/AUDIT-EXPORT.md, then pass its genesis/head as --expect-root/--expect-head).

end_marker.note: The export seal is an ordinary chained, Ed25519-signed entry (sealAndExportAuditChain): its binding is recomputed like any other record, so the counts it carries cannot be rewritten to hide a drop (EXT-022). The envelope's out-of-band signed marker additionally supplies the independent expect_head/expect_root.

integrity.note: No in-chain end marker: the end is bound by the Ed25519-signed export marker, supplied to the checker as the independent expect_head. Root: an unpruned chain starts at 64 zero bytes (kind zero); once the pruner has run, genesis advances, and the grading pipeline must set root to {kind: constant, value: <marker.genesis>} from the verified marker, which is also the independent expect_root.

loss.note: The pruner keeps the last 10,000 entries and counts what it drops; pending pruning is declared in-chain at seal time as one batched audit.pruned record (from/to ordinals, lost count). The sealed end marker states produced = delivered + pruned_total.
loss.boundary_note: At the 10,000-entry cap the oldest entries are dropped and counted (pruned_total; genesis advances to the last pruned hash). Nothing is dropped uncounted; the count is declared in-chain at seal time.

bidirectional_test.ref: tests/coverage-bidirectional.test.js: every attached source family, exercised, writes an entry; declared-unattached reads write nothing (negative control)

coverage.note: Declared as the chain's first record (declareCoverage, boot): sources enumerated from a code audit of every appendAudit call site.

policy.note: Every entry carries the digest of the active 18-check pipeline (per check: id, name, category, enforcement, sha256 of the check function's source; digest = sha256 of the JSON descriptor, served at GET /api/govern/policy). policy.changed entries record before/after digests at boot when the policy differs.

replay.reference: GET /api/govern/policy: the full descriptor (per check: id, name, category, enforcement, sha256 of the check function's source); digest = sha256(JSON.stringify(descriptor)). Checks are pure functions of the input payload (see server/lib/governance.js header); re-run the pipeline on the recorded input to replay a verdict.

independence.boundary_statement: The gateway writes and signs its own trail with its ledger key; no operator statement yet names that key (planned, L3). The export marker is signed by the same key that signs entries.
